# scorm-again 3.4.6

The SCORM 1.2 and SCORM 2004 runtimes Learn's player gives SCORM packages (`src/Scorm.tsx`):
[scorm-again](https://github.com/jcputney/scorm-again) by Jonathan Putney, MIT licensed
(`LICENSE.txt`, the package's own).

`8603c0b7e36f64d162eed3ec462be404a12da26940510fb1e21caac8c79c529e`):

| File | From | sha256 |
|---|---|---|
| `scorm12.min.js` | `dist/scorm12.min.js` | `9d7592783a7232855e1e307951ead8c0f38ab889d9a58b7fd003f17e93b84cee` |
| `scorm2004.min.js` | `dist/scorm2004.min.js` | `b5c4c9513d34044a48a8b3147a3052c8dfb345a2d976bf11f688fa5c07a0bdf4` |

To update, take the same two files of a newer release, check its licence, and record them here.
